summary: Armin Ronacher, Python developer, Flask creator, open source advocate, strong opinions on web frameworks, expertise in WSGI and web development, critical of Python 3 transition, active in Python community, based in Europe, interest in JavaScript frameworks, experience with middleware systems, engaged in discussions about software design patterns, advocates for strong security practices in web applications, has a background in computer science, involved in open source projects, has a history of contributing to Werkzeug and Jinja2, prefers explicit over implicit programming paradigms, has a critical view of certain community behaviors, enjoys discussing technical details and best practices in programming.
